note: JOIN A KINGDOM, the hall a lord with no kingdom is shown (art/reference/kingdom_hall.png). The painting's rail is the wider, eight-entry one Wave 2 brings, so only its content area is cut (x 183 onward) and drawn where the painting has it. Rows repeat: one invitation card, one kingdom card, each cut once and drawn per kingdom; the crests on them are the kingdoms' own (icons/crest_*, by kingdom id).

crops.name: hall/header
crops.note: the vista, JOIN A KINGDOM and its line, baked; the painted HUD pills are inpainted -- the shell draws its own over them

crops.name: hall/search_field
crops.note: the search box with its magnifier; the LineEdit draws no plate of its own over it

crops.name: hall/heading_narrow
crops.note: INVITATIONS' plaque and its two rules, the word lifted: headings are set in type (INVITATIONS (3), SEARCHING...)

crops.name: hall/heading_wide
crops.note: RECOMMENDED FOR YOU's longer plaque, the words lifted, for the long headings (RESULTS FOR ...)

crops.name: hall/card_invite
crops.note: an invitation: its two plates baked. The painted crest and ACCEPT/DECLINE are lifted, row by row from the card's ground between the plates and the buttons (x 696-710), just to their own edges: the kingdom's crest and the two buttons the card names are drawn where they were.

crops.name: hall/card_kingdom
crops.note: a kingdom to join: the name plate, the lords and the laurel with their plates baked; the painted crest and JOIN lifted row by row from the ground left of JOIN (x 702-712), to their own edges

crops.name: hall/or
crops.note: OR between the kingdoms and founding, baked

crops.name: hall/card_found
crops.note: RAISE YOUR OWN BANNER: the castle medallion, its title and the plate for the price, baked; FOUND lifted (it goes dim when the server says no)

crops.name: hall/btn_green
crops.note: JOIN's green plate, the word lifted: every green button in the hall (Search, Accept, Join, Request, Found), nine-patched, its word in type

crops.name: hall/btn_dark
crops.note: DECLINE's dark plate, the word lifted: Decline, and the buttons that only say where things stand (Requested, Full, Wait)
